identity: Totemwater Reach reads its future in river knots, and the knots say something old is hungry.

quests.title: Fish for the Table
quests.text: I have listened to the water all morning, and now my stomach has joined the discussion. Bring me four Mire Carp for the table. A seer should know when to stop interpreting a sound and feed it.

variants.text: I have listened to the water all morning, and now my stomach has joined the discussion. Bring me four Mire Carp for the table. A seer should know when to stop interpreting a sound and feed it.

My fish pie has a crust, a dish and several admirers, but it is still short of fish. Bring me four Mire Carp. If you are wondering who ought to catch them, look at the person who is not holding the rolling pin.

quests.lesson: A fishing errand, a level only; Totemwater's first quest and Varda's pie.
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Draft §3 'Fisch für den Tisch': Tokai in Totemwater and Varda Copperpan in Dur Brannoc (her provisions line); lane CAPITALS adds no Mire Carp quest of its own.

quests.title: A Reading Worth Checking
quests.text: The fishers' reports sit badly with my last reading, and I would rather correct myself than lose another fisher. Secure the prepared reading cord on the bank at the {name:reading_bank} in the {name:reedbanks}, then return to me. I will read it again with their observations in mind; even a seer can pull the wrong knot tight.
quests.completion: The reading fits the broken traps and missing fishers now: the old hunger has the shape of Reed-Maw. I preferred my first interpretation, but preference is a poor guide to dangerous water.
quests.lesson: A use at a place or a day hunt; the first armor choice (one enchant, a prefix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: Hear a Second Voice
quests.text: Enashi Reedvoice hears from travellers whose boats never call at Totemwater Post. Speak to her at Reedvoice Station in the Whispering Reedlands about what they have seen. I would like to hear a second voice before becoming too fond of my own answer.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: Fences for the Weirs
quests.text: The fishers need to mend their weirs, and I have offered all the wise advice they can stand. Bring me eight Jungle Wood Fences for the repairs. They were quite clear that the next contribution should be made of wood.
quests.lesson: A later errand or use; the second armor choice (one enchant, a suffix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: The Name Beneath the Water
quests.text: Fishers are missing, traps are broken, and the survivors recognise Crocodile Reed-Maw in the swamp {dir_from_giver:reed_maw_crocodile}. That is enough for me to name the danger without asking anyone to wait for another reading. Kill Reed-Maw and bring me word. An old hunger with jaws needs a firmer answer than a clever knot.
quests.completion: Reed-Maw is dead, and the fishers can work without that old hunter waiting for them. The hunger in my reading had a name and a body after all; I will remember the people who helped us recognise it.
quests.lesson: The named leader; the weapon choice (prefix and suffix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged).

quests.title: Knots for Bannerbreak
quests.text: Yarra Standardmender at Tornstandard Hold on Bannerbreak Mesa needs help with banners that must endure more than weather. Go and speak to her. She and I both work with cord, though her knots have rather less patience for interpretation.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The departure id stays; free from 29, it requires nothing.

quests.title: What the Dark Drags In
quests.text: Sedge Oozes spread through the jungle at night, catching the porters coming back to camp in the muck. Destroy three Sedge Oozes at night in the {name:jungle}, which lies {zone_area:jungle}. I want the whole crew back, including the bits they usually wear on their feet.

variants.text: Sedge Oozes spread through the jungle at night, catching the porters coming back to camp in the muck. Destroy three Sedge Oozes at night in the {name:jungle}, which lies {zone_area:jungle}. I want the whole crew back, including the bits they usually wear on their feet.

quests.notes: Round 58 camp hunt: one shared quest per camp band and clock, given by the camps' foremen; a role near the camp (the camps' level belt L21-23) that the zone's own quests do not hunt yet, met only at night (a third of the day count).
